title: get_ero input
description: One Ero with its Skemo, the Reguloj that judge it, the recorded examples, its projections in every Celo and, since Spec 007, its Uzo: purpose, what to use instead, boundaries (with action ask-human, use-instead or not-supported), composition, slot rules, layout and text rules, each with its kialo. Name the Ero by name or by ID. With brief: true only what a choice needs (purpose, axes with values and default, required props and slots, instead, boundary), generated and under a measured size ceiling.

brief.description: Only the brief answer (Spec 007 A8): ero, purpose, axes, required, instead, boundary. The boundaries carry case, action and the Ero to use, no kialo (Nachlese 3 G4): ask without brief for the kialo. Default false.

lingvo.description: The language of the texts of the answer (Nachlese 8 ③): "de" gives the purpose, the kialoj and the Reguloj in German, from data/tradukoj.json; without it or with "en" English, the source. Names, cases and keywords stay.
